name: 48623 · Freeland, MI
findings: ZIP 48623 (Freeland) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48623 (Freeland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48623 (Freeland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
